### What it covers

| Section | Content |
|--------|---------|
| **Views / screens** | Ticket list, create, detail (read + update hub), comment composer, ask/assistant; explicit **no delete** (not in PDF) |

| **RAG (UI)** | Backend pipeline invisible; freshness verified via edit → ask; no admin/vector browser |
| **AI Q&A** | Ask panel layout, loading/success/error vs **200** no-match, citations as links to detail, PDF example questions, guardrails (no agent UI) |
| **Flows A–E** | UI screen mapping for demo and AC traceability |
| **Acceptance** | **AC-UI-01…12** for review-spec / review-frontend |
